results.title: The Dallas Cowboys Players in the Most Danger of Being Cut
results.description: NFL roster cuts are just around the corner. Here are the Dallas Cowboys players who could be on the chopping block.

results.title: Jürgen Klopp begins stint as Germany’s soccer coach with talk of resigning
results.description: In a combative first news conference, the ex-Liverpool manager warned the German media he’ll quit if he believes they’re intruding on his family’s privacy.

results.title: Watch Tyson Fury KISS Mariusz Wach before delivering seventh-round KO in fight in Thailand
results.description: TYSON FURY left fans stunned after planting a cheeky KISS on Mariusz Wach before stopping the veteran Pole via TKO after the seventh round.
